summary_for_children: An-Nahl is the surah of the bee. It shows Allah's blessings in bees, honey, milk, rain, the sea, birds and animals, and asks us to be grateful.
environment_concept: A valley of blessings: rounded cliffs and a tree with bees' homes and wooden hives (16:68), honey jars in different colours (16:69), a pasture with a fold and a barn (16:5-6, 16:66), a lagoon with a boat and pearl shells (16:14) and birds held up in the sky (16:79). No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Flower meadows, cliffs and trees with hives, a stream, grazing animals, birds in the sky, and a coast.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Secret World of Bees
story_library.children_narration: Tiny bees fly from flower to flower, collecting nectar and returning to their homes. Their work helps us understand one of the many wonders of creation. Surah An-Nahl tells us that Allah inspired the bees and describes the drink that comes from within them, with different colors and benefits for people. The surah also reminds us of other blessings: rain, fruits, animals, shelter, and the world around us. Even the smallest creature can remind us to be grateful.

world_idea.title: Honeybee Kingdom
world_idea.description: Children explore a detailed meadow at insect scale, follow animated bees, identify flowers, investigate the life of a beehive, and learn about pollination and honey.
